items.title: Романтическое боке — 6 световых оверлеев
items.description: Набор из 6 универсальных световых и боке-наложений на чёрном фоне для режима Screen: портреты, love-story и весенние баннеры.
items.package_contents: План: 6 отдельных PNG (цель 3000×2000 px, чёрный фон для Screen) + инструкция по наложению и LICENSE.txt
items.delivery_requirements: 6 отдельных PNG (цель 3000×2000 px при сохранении качества): VARIANT = soft rose-gold circular bokeh clusters; subtle heart-shaped out-of-focus bokeh lights; warm champagne sparkle dust; delicate sunset prism rainbow flare; warm amber-pink edge light leak; dreamy soft rose-gold haze glow. Проверить чистый чёрный RGB 0,0,0 и Screen blending в Photoshop; не выдавать чёрный фон за прозрачность.
items.prompt: Create ONE isolated photographic light-effect overlay on a perfectly solid pure black RGB 0,0,0 background. The effect is [VARIANT]. Soft realistic optical bokeh and luminous glow, clean isolated edges, delicate smooth gradients, no foreground objects, no text, no logos, no watermark, no grain or gray haze in the black background, horizontal 3:2. Preserve pure black background for Photoshop Screen blending. Output one asset per generation, not a contact sheet.

items.prompt: Generate ONE photorealistic isolated floating flower-petal overlay on a solid pure black RGB 0,0,0 background. [VARIANT]. Natural varied petal shapes and gentle motion blur, plausible depth of field, warm soft studio rim light on petals, no stems, ground, sky, scenery, letters, or branding. Clean pure black areas without gray haze, horizontal 3:2, no borders or mockup. Output one effect per generation.

Neutral warm-gray matte clay material, plain light gray background, even diffuse studio light, centered, square 1:1. Orthographic view, no wide-angle perspective, no text, labels, logos or watermark.
